svg.title: PxModRim installed-mod memory profile
svg.desc: Measured memray allocation peaks, decoded image payloads, WebP disk cache sizes, metadata costs, and controlled virtual versus nonvirtual grid retention. Exact bytes are included alongside binary MiB units.
svg.text: PxModRim · 2,041 installed mods · 1,512 PNG previews · Python 3.12.13 / Qt offscreen
all previews retained · lower is better
Live memray allocations: metadata + images + decode/conversion scratch
setScaledSize bounds the output; PNG still needs full-resolution decode scratch.
WebP is smaller on disk, not compressed in display RAM. QPixmap conversion can allocate another bitmap.
Largest source dimensions in corpus: up to 5,333 px wide / 3,000 px high.
compressed file bytes · no source files changed
17.17× smaller · 94.18% less disk space · temporary thumbnail cache removed after profiling
Grid retention · visit every row, retain only the viewport
Virtual peak: 149.28 MiB; nonvirtual peak: 1,502.47 MiB. Large PNG scratch still spikes.
peak live stacks · each column is a separate run
SQLite is closed after discovery: its allocations are absent at the later image/grid peak, not unmeasured.
Metadata baseline · real discovery, models, SQLite cache
SQLite database: 4.08 MiB (4,280,320 B). Cache improves parsing time, not the model-retention floor.
Measured on Linux x86_64 · Python 3.12.13 · memray 1.20.0 · QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen.
Comparison workers are isolated; Qt/import baseline is excluded from memray allocations, but included in JSON RSS figures.
Grid uses one QWidget + two QLabels per delegate and real corpus previews; production QML ListView already reuses items.
529 mods lack About/Preview.png. Grid images cycle through the corpus so every delegate has the same workload.
Breakdown: native sqlite3 frames, image/pixmap frames, widget-construction frames, Python allocator records, then other.
Outer HTML flamegraph also includes imports and thumbnail encoding. Its total peak is not the isolated comparison peak.
Exact bytes, sampled RSS, timing, and methodology: installed-memory-profile.json · CLI summary: installed-memory-stats.json.
